name: Stronghold
description: Stronghold is a singleplayer and multiplayer real-time strategy and castle-building game and the first in the Stronghold series.

gog.store_details: Sold only on GOG, as 'Stronghold HD' — the original 2001 Firefly Studios build. Steam delisted it in favour of the 2023 'Definitive Edition' remaster, which uses a different engine without DirectSound3D EAX.
